title: Joining Further Late-Filed TRICARE Select Lines to an Open Claim Factual Reconsideration — Appeals and Grievances Desk Guide
content:
Appeals and Grievances desk guide — further late-filed TRICARE Select lines joining an open Claim Factual Reconsideration

**Rule.** Further TRICARE Select postings of one claim still standing with the same late-filing denial as a line already under an open Claim Factual Reconsideration join that case one at a time, each keeping its own line reference.

**Prerequisite.** The amount recorded for a further line joining a reconsideration is fixed only after a Claim Factual Reconsideration stands filed or under review on an earlier line of the same claim carrying the same denial.

**Subject and timeliness.** A joining line is recorded under the Claim Factual Reconsideration it joins with the claim line itself as its subject, which is a kind of subject that tier hears. A line joins in time when the day its record is received is no later than the joining line's posted date plus the tier's filing deadline in calendar days, counted from the day after that posted date, a record received on the last of those days being in time.

**Points of judgement**

- Each joining posting is a record of its own, with its own line reference; postings join one at a time, never several in one record.
- The deadline for a joining line runs from that joining line's own posted date. Hypothetical: a joining line posted on day P with the Claim Factual Reconsideration filing deadline of N calendar days joins in time if its record is received on the day P plus N days, and not if received the day after.

## Invocation: `join_select_line_reconsideration_711ff8e9`

**Capability.** The appellant joins, in their own name, a further denied line of a TRICARE Select claim to the Claim Factual Reconsideration already open on that claim. One call records the joining line as its own case record keeping its own line reference: it is recorded as received today on the standard review track with status filed, under the same claim number, with the line's own determination date, who is filing and the amount in dispute given (the amount the case carries once this line has joined it); no appointment of representative is marked as on file. The appellant can follow the joined line with the rest of the case on the beneficiary web portal and through customer service.

**Invocation and owner.** A customer-run tool: the agent unlocks `join_select_line_reconsideration_711ff8e9` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the beneficiary reference number of the patient the claim line belongs to, as returned by the beneficiary profile lookup (an identifier) | identifier |
| `subject_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the adjudicated TRICARE Select claim line that joins the open case, as returned by the Select claim line lookup | identifier |
| `subject_referral_authorization_id` | a denied authorization the case is about; a claim line case concerns no authorization, so the empty string "" is passed (the authorization lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_enrollment_id` | an enrollment ended for nonpayment the case is about; a claim line case concerns no enrollment, so the empty string "" is passed (the enrollment lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_claim_number` | the claim number of that line as printed on the Explanation of Benefits and shown on the claim line record returned by the Select claim line lookup | verbatim: copied character for character with its letters, digits and hyphens, with no normalisation, addition or deletion |
| `initial_determination_date` | the date of the determination on the joining line | YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time or time zone) |
| `filed_by` | who is filing, one of: `beneficiary` (the patient files their own case); `parent_or_guardian` (a parent or legal guardian files for a minor or incapacitated patient); `appointed_representative` (a person the patient has appointed files on the patient's behalf); `participating_provider` (a participating provider files on its own denied claim) | one of the four values listed |
| `amount_in_dispute` | the amount in dispute recorded on the joining line in USD, 2 decimal places (cents), a non-negative number, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed | USD, 2 decimals, non-negative, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** "Claim line [line] joined to the reconsideration on claim [claim number] as record [record id]: status filed, received [YYYY-MM-DD], amount in dispute [amount] USD." — the received date is today's date and the amount is the booked amount with two decimals. The presence of the record reference number indicates that the line was joined.
